w10_T4_001132: Rae had 221 glass beads and used 193 of them on a necklace. She gave 17 beads to her friend Sol, who then had more beads than Rae had left. Rae sold each of her remaining beads for 5 cents and received a 28-cent tip from the buyer. She checks her stall twice a day, and the same thing happened on each of 4 days. How many cents did Rae take over those 4 days?
w10_T4_001134: In the morning a library display held 110 bookmarks, and 18 were taken by readers before noon. In the afternoon a volunteer placed a matching bookmark beside every one on the display, so there were 2 of each. The library has 5 floors. In the evening 60 bookmarks were taken by a school group, and then 18 more were taken by visitors. How many bookmarks were on the display at closing time?
w10_T4_001139: Ben's hens gave him 232 eggs this week. His neighbour Ana, whose hens laid fewer eggs than Ben's, gave him 52 eggs, and he bought 55 more from a farm shop. His stall is 3 metres wide. Ben sold every egg for 7 cents. He then spent 2352 cents on chicken feed. How many cents did Ben have left?
w10_T4_001142: A print shop is making booklets of 73 pages each, and it needs 9 booklets for one set. It adds 50 cover and title pages to each set. The shop prints 2 copies of each set, and it must send the copies to 2 different schools, so it prints the whole order once for each school. It also prints 12 spare pages. How many pages does the shop print altogether?
w10_T4_001145: Mo walks 196 steps to the bus stop each day and 22 more steps to the shop next to it, and this takes about half an hour of his morning. He does this on each of 5 days. On the last day he also walked 24 steps to a post box and 55 steps to a cafe. How many steps did Mo walk in total on these trips?
w10_T4_001147: A cafe orders paper cups in boxes. Each box holds 142 large cups and 48 small cups. The cafe ordered 9 boxes for the month. During the month it used 1079 cups, and 34 cups were found crushed and thrown away. How many cups does the cafe have left?
w10_T4_001149: Lena practises the piano for 21 minutes and then plays scales for 9 minutes, so each session is half an hour. Her piano has 88 keys. She does 3 sessions a day for 5 days. Her brother Kit practises much less than Lena. This week she missed 183 minutes of her planned practice. Her tutor awards 3 points for every minute actually practised. How many points does Lena earn this week?
w10_T4_001151: In the morning Yara picked 98 plums, and her friend Zed, who picked fewer plums than Yara, gave her his 52 plums. In the afternoon she sold every plum for 3 cents each by half past two, and then spent 435 cents on a basket. In the evening she shared the money that was left equally among her 3 children. Her son Ravi then found 11 cents under the sofa and added it to his share. How many cents does Ravi have?
w10_T4_001152: In the morning a beekeeper found 97 grams of honey in each frame, with another 12 grams of wax-honey on each frame. There are 8 frames in every hive and 7 hives in the apiary. In the afternoon she added 41 grams she had scraped from a lid. In the evening the owner Ola noted that the farm runs 7 apiaries exactly like this one, and her assistant Ben confirmed that his count matched hers. How many grams did the whole farm collect?
w10_T4_001157: Iris earns 224 cents an hour at a shop and works 3 hours each day. Each day she also gets a 7-cent tip and 58 cents from returning bottles, which brings her daily money to a little over seven dollars. Her friend Tam, who works at the same shop twice a week, earns less per hour than Iris. How many cents does Iris collect over 7 days?
w10_T4_001158: In the morning 189 minutes of chores, a little over three hours, were shared equally among 3 siblings. Tess finished her share 17 minutes faster than planned each day, and in the afternoon she did her whole set of chores twice. She kept to this routine for 4 days. In the evening of the last day she spent 56 minutes tidying the garage. How many minutes of chores did Tess do in total?
w10_T4_001163: Kim had 37 coins in her collection, and she got 40 more from her grandfather. She found 5 coins in an old drawer. She gave 15 coins to her friend Jay, who then had fewer coins than Kim. She swapped away 20 coins at a fair, and later bought 70 coins from a dealer who had traded for a dozen years. How many coins does Kim have now?
w10_T4_001166: In the morning Cam sold 126 cups of lemonade at his stand and then 10 more. His stand is 4 metres long. In the afternoon he counted that every cup sold for 2 dollars, that is two hundred cents. He sold the same number of cups every day for 7 days. In the evening of the last day he spent 1673 dollars on a new bicycle. How many dollars does Cam have left?
w10_T4_001168: In the morning the bike rack at the station held 196 bikes, and 61 more were parked before half past nine. In the afternoon 30 bikes arrived. In the evening 188 bikes were collected by their owners, and then 66 more were taken. How many bikes were still in the rack at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001173: Mia, who is 9 years old, had 20 stickers. She gave 8 stickers to her brother and shared the rest equally among her 4 friends. Her friend Ola took her share home. Ola then received 45 stickers from her aunt, 18 from a magazine, and 21 from a school prize, and she checks her album twice a week. How many stickers does Ola have?
w10_T4_001177: Dan puts 146 dollars into savings every month and adds a 36-dollar bonus each month. Each month he takes out 29 dollars for his phone and 96 dollars for his bus pass. His sister Uma, who checks her account twice a week, saves less each month than Dan. Dan follows this pattern for 4 months, and the bank then charges him a 21-dollar fee. How many dollars does Dan have in savings?
w10_T4_001183: A farm with a dozen workers harvests 219 kilograms of potatoes from each plot. There are 6 plots in every field and 7 fields on the farm, and the harvest took 3 days. The crop is shared equally among 6 buyers, so the buyer Wren receives exactly as much as the buyer Pax. Wren then sells 1060 kilograms to a restaurant. How many kilograms does Wren have left?
w10_T4_001190: In the morning a brickworks loaded 68 bricks on each pallet and 8 pallets on each truck, and 9 trucks were filled. In the afternoon 53 loose bricks were added to the order. In the evening the foreman Ivo priced every brick at 8 cents, and his colleague Jun's count came to the same total. How many cents is the whole order worth?
w10_T4_001194: Sam earns 201 cents an hour, but 37 cents of every hour's pay is withheld for tax. He works 6 hours a day. Each day he also gets tips of 61 cents and 71 cents, which he adds to his pay. His brother Lou earns less per hour than Sam. Sam works like this for 9 days and takes a half-hour break each day. He then spends 3761 cents on a jacket. How many cents does Sam have left?
w10_T4_001209: There were 34 ducks on the village pond, which is 40 metres wide. 28 ducks flew off to the river. Then 10 ducks landed on the pond. 13 ducks walked off to the field, and after that 50 ducks arrived from the lake. Finally 26 ducks flew away. How many ducks are on the pond now?
w10_T4_001213: A candle maker filled 6 boxes with 159 candles each. She sent half of the candles to a market in another town and kept the rest in her shop. She sold 401 candles from the shop, and then 34 unsold candles came back from the market. A donor then matched every candle she had, doubling her stock. How many candles does she have now?
w10_T4_001222: In the morning a grocer had 233 tomatoes, and 67 of them were too soft to sell. He shared the rest equally between his 2 stalls. In the afternoon the worker at the first stall cut every tomato there into 4 slices. In the evening every slice from that stall was sold for 2 cents. How many cents did the first stall take from the slices?
w10_T4_001223: Gia had 106 lemons. She sold 38 lemons and gave 36 to her cousin Hal, who then had more lemons than Gia had left. Each remaining lemon makes 6 cups of lemonade. Hal brought over 52 cups of his own lemonade to add to hers. Every cup sells for 8 cents, so all the cups together are worth a little under twenty dollars. Gia then spent 179 cents on sugar. How many cents did Gia have after buying the sugar?
w10_T4_001233: A hall had 172 chairs set out in a dozen rows. 23 chairs were moved to another room, and 10 broken chairs were thrown out. The hall is 25 metres long. 3 chairs were found in a cupboard and added, and then 32 chairs were delivered. Each chair weighs 3 kilograms. How many kilograms do the chairs in the hall weigh in total?
w10_T4_001238: Pat had 217 stamps. He gave a dozen stamps to his nephew, and then sold 113 stamps to a collector. A dealer valued every stamp he had left at 5 cents. Pat decided to give half of that value to charity and keep the rest. How many cents did Pat keep?
